news.title: ASX pares gains as inflation figures put pressure on RBA
news.snippet: The Australian sharemarket has shed some of its morning gains after the release of the nation’s latest inflation figures increased pressure on the Reserve Bank to lift interest rates at its meeting next week.

news.title: Thank you, Mr President: BlueScope gets a windfall from Trump’s tariffs
news.snippet: Donald Trump’s tariffs on steel imports have kicked off a bonanza for steel producers in the US, including BlueScope. They’re a pain for the wider economy.

news.title: Dateline pledges to deliver US gold vision of late chairman
news.snippet: Dateline Resources has vowed to advance its billion-dollar Colosseum gold project in California following the passing of longtime chairman Mark Johnson.

news.title: ‘Profit over compliance’: Star hit with $260m fine for money laundering breaches
news.snippet: The Federal Court has hit the casino operator with a much larger fine than it says it can afford.

news.title: Forrestania adds more gold ounces to WA production pipeline
news.snippet: Forrestania Resources has tabled a 25,800oz gold resource at its Symes Find project, adding inventory ahead of a planned mid-December restart at its Edna May plant in WA.

Hastings completes US$15M Thai rare earths plant deal
news.snippet: Hastings Technology Metals has finalised a US$15 million deal for its Thai rare earths plant, with first production slated for the second quarter of next year.

news.title: Aurum powers past 3.8Moz gold at West African flagship
news.snippet: Aurum Resources has boosted its Boundiali resource in Côte d’Ivoire by 19% to 3.84 million ounces of gold, swelling the indicated category to 2.33 million ounces.

news.title: McLaren adds fresh upside to monster WA mineral sands play
news.snippet: McLaren Minerals has uncovered a potential new mineral-rich shoreline east of its WA deposit, with drill holes 6km apart hitting high-grade zones of up to 13.26% heavy minerals.
